name: AH Amyloidosis

criteria.description: Demonstration of amyloid deposits by Congo red staining with apple-green birefringence under polarized light
Identification of immunoglobulin heavy chain deposits by immunohistochemistry or mass spectrometry
Exclusion of AL (light chain) amyloidosis by absence of light chain deposits
Presence of organ dysfunction consistent with amyloid deposition (e.g., renal, cardiac involvement)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation of amyloid deposits with immunohistochemical identification of heavy chain deposits and exclusion of light chain amyloidosis
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Mass spectrometry is considered the gold standard for amyloid typing when available.

laboratory: Proteinuria with nephrotic range protein loss
Elevated serum creatinine indicating renal impairment
Serum and urine immunofixation negative for light chains
imaging: Echocardiogram showing restrictive cardiomyopathy with thickened ventricular walls
MRI or nuclear imaging demonstrating amyloid deposits in affected organs
genetic: No known germline mutations; typically acquired amyloidosis
other: Tissue biopsy with Congo red staining and immunohistochemical typing
Mass spectrometry for amyloid protein subtyping

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of light chain deposits instead of heavy chains
More frequent cardiac involvement with rapid progression
Serum or urine monoclonal light chains detected
Amyloid deposits composed of serum amyloid A protein

redFlags: Restrictive cardiomyopathy with preserved ejection fraction
Unexplained peripheral neuropathy in context of systemic amyloidosis
references: Merlini G, Bellotti V. Molecular mechanisms of amyloidosis. N Engl J Med. 2003;349(6):583-596.
Sipe JD, Benson MD, Buxbaum JN, et al. Nomenclature 2014: Amyloid fibril proteins and clinical classification of the amyloidosis. Amyloid. 2014;21(4):221-224.
Gertz MA. Immunoglobulin heavy chain amyloidosis (AH amyloidosis): diagnosis and treatment. Hematology Am Soc Hematol Educ Program. 2015;2015:1-7.
